name: Algebraic Indicator Formulation
description: Replaces the pairwise boolean-like negative yield condition with an algebraic function $I(v) = v(2s_{|v|} - 1) + |v|$ that maps true literals to positive numbers and false literals to zero. The constraint is framed as a sum $I(l_1) + I(l_2) > 0$. This hides the boolean OR logic and the direct 2-SAT structure behind integer arithmetic, forcing models to algebraically derive the boolean equivalence rather than pattern-matching DIMACS-style text.
